title: Restaurant Style Paneer Butter Masala
transcript: Heat butter and oil in a pan, add cardamom, cloves, cinnamon. Saute onions and ginger garlic paste until aromatic. Add fresh tomato puree, cashews, chili powder, and cook until oil separates. Blend into a velvety smooth gravy, add fresh paneer cubes, kasuri methi, garam masala, and fresh cream. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot with naan.

title: Authentic Mexican Street Tacos
transcript: Season the flank steak with cumin, chili powder, lime juice, and garlic. Sear on high heat in a cast iron skillet until caramelized. Warm the corn tortillas, slice steak against the grain, top with diced onion, fresh cilantro, and salsa verde.

title: Simple Chicken Curry for Beginners
transcript: Heat mustard oil in a heavy bottom pan. Add whole spices like bay leaf, cloves, and cardamom. Add sliced onions and cook until deep golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste, tomato puree, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Saute until oil separates, then add chicken pieces. Sear on high heat for 5 minutes, then add hot water, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until tender and juicy. Garnish with fresh cilantro and garam masala.

title: Authentic Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
transcript: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, biryani masala, mint, and fried onions for 1 hour. Parboil long grain basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked. Layer the marinated chicken and scented rice in a heavy pot. Sprinkle saffron milk, ghee, mint leaves, and fried onions. Seal tightly and cook on slow dum heat for 25-30 minutes.

title: Gordon Ramsay Cooks Up Delicious 10-Minute Pasta
transcript: Bring salted water to a rolling boil. Drop pasta and cook al dente. In a skillet, heat extra virgin olive oil with sliced garlic, red chili, and cherry tomatoes. Deglaze with pasta water to emulsify. Toss the pasta directly into the sauce. Finish with fresh basil, cracked black pepper, lemon juice, and grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Veg Chowmein & Hakka Noodles Street Style
transcript: Boil noodles in salted water until 80% done, rinse in cold water and toss with oil. In a smoking hot wok, stir fry chopped garlic, ginger, and green chilies. Toss shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, and sliced onions on high heat. Add the boiled noodles, soy sauce, green chili sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and salt. Toss vigorously over screaming hot flame and garnish with spring onions.

title: Lucknowi Vegetable Dum Biryani
transcript: Marinate carrots, cauliflower, French beans, green peas, and paneer cubes in spiced yogurt. Parboil long grain basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked. Layer marinated vegetables and scented rice in a heavy handi. Drizzle saffron milk, desi ghee, mint leaves, and fried onions. Seal tightly and cook on slow dum heat for 25-30 minutes.
